name: Are property taxes a significant factor in the South Florida cost of living?

mainEntity.name: Are property taxes a significant factor in the South Florida cost of living?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, property taxes are a significant consideration when assessing the cost of living in South Florida. Taxes are calculated based on the assessed value of your property and vary by county and specific taxing districts. New residents often benefit from Florida's homestead exemption if the property is their primary residence, which can reduce the taxable value. Understanding these taxes is crucial before purchasing, as they contribute substantially to your monthly housing expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property taxes are a significant factor in South Florida's cost of living, varying by county and property value. Florida's homestead exemption can reduce the taxable value for primary residences.
